items.headline: Dormant $QNT Whales Move $10M as Quant Price Surges
items.summary: Whales dormant for three years moved nearly $10M in $QNT as Quant's price surged. Onchain watchers are eyeing whether more old wallets wake up.

items.headline: $AZTEC Relaunches zk.money Privacy Wallet on Ethereum L2
items.summary: Aztec Labs relaunched zk.money, a self-custodial privacy wallet, on its Ethereum Layer 2, three years after shutting the original. Privacy DeFi is back for $AZTEC.

items.headline: Coinbase Adds $HYPE as Collateral for $100K Loans
items.summary: Coinbase now lets eligible US users borrow up to $100,000 against $HYPE and $ZEC via Morpho on Base, a fresh DeFi use case for the Hyperliquid token.

items.headline: First US Spot $NEAR ETF Launches With Staking Rewards
items.summary: Bitwise launched NRR, the first US spot $NEAR ETP with a 0.75% fee, staking its holdings in-house so rewards flow to shareholders via NAV.

items.headline: $SHIB Account Follows Tiny Token, Memecoin Buzz Erupts
items.summary: Shiba Inu's official X account followed an obscure token with just 700 followers, sending $SHIB fans into a frenzy of speculation over what comes next.
